what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Bangladesh in Brazil: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 848 Bangladeshi asylum seekers in Brazil, 0.9% of all asylum seekers from Bangladesh.
Refugees from Bangladesh, a separate group, live mostly in France, Canada, the United Kingdom and the United States.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Bangladesh in 2005 and 2006, and with the Islamic State group in 2016 and 2017.
The fact pack does not link these conflicts to the asylum figures.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2008 at 5 asylum seekers.
The figure was at its highest, 5715, at the end of 2021; the main years of displacement in the data are 2017 to 2022.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Brazil.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for Brazil only.
